metadata.desc: HTML/template to image rendering inside the AstrBot process, ready to be used as AstrBot's text-to-image endpoint without an extra container. Built on the official text-to-image service with an identical interface and behavior.

fonts.title: T2I Service Panel
fonts.subtitle: Provides fonts for text-to-image rendering without touching the upstream render logic. Font files live under fonts/ in the plugin data directory and take effect when the render process starts.

action.refreshHint: Rewrite the font config and reload rendering

warn.disabled: Fonts are disabled in the plugin config (fonts.enabled), so download and upload will not take effect.
warn.api: This AstrBot version does not support plugin page APIs (4.24.1 or newer is required). The font directory and config keys still work, but this page cannot download or upload fonts.

state.pending: Fonts not in effect yet, applied on the next render

installed.title: Installed fonts
installed.empty: The font directory is still empty. Upload a font or download one from a link to start.

specimen.title: Font specimen self-check
specimen.hint: Renders one line per selected family with the plugin renderer; with nothing selected every installed font is compared. Use the box above to compare specific characters. If a line looks identical to the others, that font is not really in effect.
specimen.caption: Comparing {count} families: {list}
specimen.textPlaceholder: Custom text to compare (empty = default sentence)

add.title: Add fonts
add.hint: Supports .ttf / .otf / .ttc files and checks that the file really is a font. You can also paste a direct link — when the name is left empty it is taken from the link. Use a GitHub proxy (e.g. the https://gh-proxy.com/ prefix) for large files.

project.desc: These fonts are organised around the layout needs of astrbot_plugin_qq_group_daily_analysis（群聊日常分析）: that plugin renders group chat reports into images and picks font families and weights per template. Each template below can be installed in one go.
project.hintBefore: Other text-to-image templates can use these fonts as well — as long as the font-family in the template matches the family name inside the font file. To install your own fonts, open the
project.hintAfter: tab and upload a file or paste a link.

templates.title: Download template fonts in one go

families.title: Single font family
families.hint: The list comes from the upstream project's T2I_FONTS.md; an installed family shows Delete instead of Download.

t2i.title: T2i template fonts
t2i.desc: These are the fonts used by the T2i templates bundled with this plugin. Install a whole set or a single family (under Overview → Single font family); after installing, hit "Re-render" on the T2i templates tab to see the new glyphs.

t2i.title: T2i templates
t2i.hint: Once applied, AstrBot renders messages with this template. The plugin plugs in through one dedicated slot template, so switching styles only rewrites the slot content — AstrBot's template name stays put.
t2i.restart: AstrBot reads the template name only at startup; restart it once and this template takes effect.
t2i.loadFailed: Could not load the template list; check the plugin version and the AstrBot log
t2i.previewFailed: Preview rendering failed — check the log to see whether Chromium started

slot.strategy: Render strategy is {name}, so templates are ignored

t2i.toastApplied: Switched to {name}; the next message uses it
t2i.toastRestart: Applied {name}; restart AstrBot to take effect
t2i.nameHint: Letters, digits, underscores and dashes only, starting with a letter or digit. It shows up in the template list once saved.
t2i.contentLabel: Template HTML (leave empty to use the choice above)
t2i.badName: Names may only use letters, digits, underscores and dashes, start with a letter or digit, and stay under 65 characters.
t2i.saveFailed: Could not save; check the log for details
t2i.readFailed: Could not read the template content
t2i.previewDraftEmpty: The editor is empty — write some HTML or pick starting content first.
t2i.previewDraftFailed: Preview render failed — check whether Chromium started in the log
t2i.previewPaneTitle: Preview (rendered with the sample template data, nothing is saved)
t2i.toastCreated: Created {name}; hit Apply to switch to it
t2i.toastSavedApplied: Saved {name}; hit Reapply to use the new layout
t2i.armDelete: Click again to delete the template {name}
t2i.deleteFailed: Delete failed, check the log for details
t2i.toastDeletedRestored: Deleted {name}; the one shipped with AstrBot is back
t2i.toastDeletedApplied: Deleted {name}; the plugin slot still holds a copy, so apply another template to replace it

sample.title: Preview sample text
sample.summary: The text shown inside the template previews
sample.label: Sample text (Markdown)
sample.hint: After saving, every template card is re-rendered with this text. It only affects previews, never the real output.
sample.empty: The sample text cannot be empty — use “Restore default” to go back
sample.saveFailed: Saving the sample text failed — check the log for details
sample.saved: Sample text saved; template cards are re-rendering with it
sample.resetDone: Sample text restored to the default

fontDialog.title: This template can also use the original fonts
fontDialog.body: "{name}" was designed for {originals} (bundled with Windows / macOS, usually absent on a server); the substitutes {missing} are not installed either (about {mb} MB). Installing them brings the glyphs closer to the original.
fontDialog.consequence: Rendering works either way: without the fonts the template falls back to the server's own Chinese fonts, so Japanese Mincho and Kai shapes are lost and headings and body text look different from the original template.
fontDialog.started: Font download started — re-render the preview once it finishes to see the new glyphs
fontDialog.bodyPlain: "{name}" uses {list}; still missing {missing} (about {mb} MB). Installing them brings the glyphs closer to the original template.

toast.uploadUnsupported: This AstrBot version cannot upload from a page; use a download link instead
toast.uploadNoFamily: Uploaded, but no font family name was found. Check that the file is a valid font.

toast.allInstalled: Every font family is already installed
